Order book on 1 May 2026 was ₹899 Cr, of which ₹627 Cr was outside India and ₹272 Cr within India.
Rodney Hunt order book was close to USD38-39 million; Waterfront order book was nearly GBP3 million; Jash Process Equipment (formerly WesTech) was ₹32 Cr.
Singapore rising-sea-level offers of USD800-900 million are not orders; awards start 2028 and first orders 2029.

timeline.summary: On 12 May 2026, Jash Engineering announced the postal ballot results approving the re-appointment of Suresh Patel as Executive Director.
On 13 May 2026, Jash Engineering reported April 2026 consolidated order intake of ₹72 Cr and an order book of ₹899 Cr as on 1 May 2026, of which ₹627 Cr was from markets outside India.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹290.54 Cr, net profit ₹56.65 Cr.
On May 2026, Jash Engineering reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹290.54 Cr and PAT of ₹56.65 Cr, with an order book of ₹899 Cr as on 1 May 2026.
Jash Engineering Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call for Q4FY26 and FY26 results on 27 May 2026 via its website.

On 27 May 2026, Jash Engineering's Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 total income at ₹875 Cr with a 12-13% PAT margin, against a ₹899 Cr order book on 1 May, and set a five-year plan to double revenue to ₹1,500 Cr.

upcoming_events.description: Houston and Saudi Arabia plants targeted for commissioning before December 2027

status_history.evidence: Order book as on 1 May 2026 was ₹899 Cr, disclosed in the call.

watchlist.text: Order book in the next monthly update

watchlist.response: Management declined to quantify, asking analysts to write to the company by email.
watchlist.text: Analysts asked for the forex gain in Q4FY26 and the unexecuted order book, and for a volume-versus-value split.

watchlist.response: Management said it can share the data but would have to think about making it part of the presentation.
watchlist.text: Analysts asked for standalone and consolidated working capital separately.
